description:
The Lead Software Developer is part of a team of full time employees and consulting resources that are the driving force of innovation for the Salesforce environment. The team is divided into multiple Scrum teams and work closely with product owners and Scrum Masters to build amazing platform features and functions to help our business grow. Your job as a Lead Software Developer is to have the dual role of being an expert Salesforce developer and an excellent mentor and coach ensuring each sprint adds business value and meets long term corporate goals.
 
  Major Responsibilities: 
 
 • Participate in software development on the Salesforce.com platform using Agile/Scrum methodologies. 
 • Work in a team using ETL technologies to migrate data from legacy systems to the Salesforce data model. 
 • Translate simple to complex user stories into functional and actionable software within the Salesforce environment. 
 • Be a master of balancing your availability to stakeholders for day to day activities and bringing new and innovative solutions to the team. 
 • Ensure that solutions are high quality and tuned for optimum performance. 
   
 Job Requirements 
 Attributes: 
 • Self-starter, “can-do” attitude a must in a fast-moving business and technical environment. 
 • Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively to both IT and business partners and leaders. 
 • A strong sense of methodology, process and metrics, functions, and projects. 
 • Experience/ knowledge of SEP and Agile development processes. 
   
 Minimum Requirements: 
 • 4+ years experience with SFDC Object design, SOQL & SOSL, Apex and VisualForce. 
 • 2+ years experience using ETL tools. 
 • 2+ years experience with Force.com Migration Tool. 
 • Experience developing using the Agile/Scrum methodology. 
 • Excellent communication skills. 
 • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or related field. 
   
 Preferred Requirements: 
 • Salesforce Advanced Developer Certification. 
 • Experience working in a multi-team Salesforce development environment. 
 • 2+ years experience using Informatica. 
 • Experience using Continuous Integration processes with Salesforce.com. 
 • Experience in the Telecommunications Industry.


 Salary: $110K + Bonus 
 Must be a US citizen or green card holder 
 
 Apply today!
